candidates.title: False ceiling collapses at Husnabad RTC bus station
candidates.excerpt: A false ceiling at the Husnabad RTC bus station collapsed in the early hours of Thursday following continuous rains. No passengers were injured as the incident occurred when the station was largely empty. Passengers sought a probe into the incident.

candidates.title: Defence minister felicitates expedition crew summitting 20 unclimbed peaks in Ladakh
candidates.excerpt: In a momentous ceremony, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh honored a mountaineering team that reached a groundbreaking summit. Over 23 days, the team conquered 20 previously untrodden peaks soaring above 6,000 meters in Ladakh. Led by Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal from the National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports, Dirang, their remarkable feat emphasizes India's strength in mountaineering and enhances its stature on the global stage.
